programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S1 E17 — CalypsoAt school, Bluey and friends throw themselves into various games. Teacher Calypso keeps them on track with a wise word and a song, all except the mysterious Pretzel.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S3 E12 — The Opposites BadgeNorrie is having fun looking at nature in the garden. When Roly wants to join in, she tells him he needs to be really quiet, but he gets overexcited, shouting so loudly that he scares a lovely butterfly away. Norrie is put out because Roly did the opposite of what she said. When Roly asks what an opposite is, Norrie struggles to explain. Luckily, Duggee has his Opposites Badge and helps the squirrels understand by using lots of fun examples.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: S2 E6 — Chantelle and Rory: HedgehogsRishaan finds out all about his favourite teeny tiny creature, the hedgehog. Chantelle meets Kyra and Sophie, two young, passionate hedgehog rescuers, while Rory and his son Sandy are in their garden finding ways to spot hedgehogs.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: S6 E8 — Ted Goes to the BeachTed and his family head to the beach, and Ted tries his hand at making a sandcastle. When it doesn't go quite to plan, Dad shows him some top tips.

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: S2 — Hatty the HedgehogThe chefs are having a scavenger hunt in the café, finding spiky things. Hattie the spiky hedgehog comes to visit, Small flies off to find out how flour is made, and the two chefs whisk up delicious hedgehog rolls for their snuffly guest.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: S3 E2 — Mission: Talent ShowTherapy dog Toffee and his owner Helen help Betty and Pop-Pop feel brave enough to perform at their talent show at the Woofton Care Home.

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: S2 E12 — Aneeshwar and Lizzie: Zebra and Red-Bellied PiranhaAneeshwar and Lizzie head to a safari park to meet a herd of zebras. They reveal that a zebra's stripes are unique to each individual. Not one zebra looks the same. Next, Aneeshwar and Lizzie encounter some red-bellied piranhas. These fish have huge teeth, and they see a large shoal of piranhas right in front of them being fed their breakfast. Finally, Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the wild connection is between these two incredible animals.

programme.title: What's in Your Bag?
programme.desc: S1 E2 — DentistDr Milad the dentist explains how his dental mirror helps him to check that teeth are strong and healthy.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: S3 E13 — Helpful WaffleWaffle, Jess, Gramps and Angela help Pepper find a new owner by making a leaflet. Waffle tries to help Mrs Hobbs, too, but causes chaos. He hopes Mrs Hobbs will adopt Pepper.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: S3 E5 — Dandelion DriftWhen Lala and Baba's 'fluffy' disintegrates, they must patiently await the growth of a new one.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: S1 E16 — Yeehaa!When Sonny finds an old line-dancing record, Yukee thinks it would be a mighty swell idea if the gang had a line dance in the Sunhouse. But when remembering the moves proves a problem for the gang, Yukee must find a way to help them.

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: S1 E12 — Counting SpaghettiLu and Barnaby have a disagreement during art time at Shell School.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: S1 E25 — CloudFiona longs to experience floating on a cloud. The Piggies craft a homemade floating cushion, but it is so comfortable that Wilf dozes off on it and drifts away.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: S1 E12 — The Whole of MeThe Numberblocks show us what they are made of in a song and dance all about the parts that make a whole. Find out how to split numbers into smaller numbers with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: S6 E14 — P's Perfect PaintingThe Alphablocks learn to read the titles Ben the Pen writes under their new artworks.

programme.title: Something Special

programme.title: Teletubbies

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: S1 E7 — Zebra MischiefThe zebras are up to mischief, Hamza spots wild warthogs and takes on a smelly task.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: S1 E14 — Carousel and Wax CrayonsMaddie goes for a fun day out. She visits a fairground and goes for a ride on a carousel, using a special camera to find out how it works. Next, Maddie visits a factory to see how different coloured wax crayons are made from paraffin oil.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines

They're in charge of baking and decorating a delicious birthday cake, with help from Mrs Bailey. Theo and Jasper are making a beautiful birthday crown for Miss Gerrard to wear, and have asked Mrs Hussain to help them. With everything ready, it's time for the surprise party!

programme.title: Our Family

programme.title: Vegesaurs

programme.title: Peter Rabbit

BaBa still wants to copy MeMo and is sad at Yummy Time when MeMo and the Yummies play something else. MeMo doesn't want BaBa to be sad. With the help of the Yummies, MeMo finds a happy way to compromise.

On his travels, Ben meets baseball players, drops a 10kg weight on a sheep's skull and finds out that by not having a penis bone humans are very much in the minority.

programme.title: Gareth Edwards' Great Welsh Adventure

programme.title: The Normans

He tells how the Normans established their new province of Normandy - 'land of the Northmen' - in northern France. They went on to build some of the finest churches in Europe and turned into an unstoppable force of Christian knights and warriors.

programme.title: Storyville
programme.desc: A Want in HerDebut feature documentary from filmmaker and artist Myrid Carten, which unfolds as a powerful exploration of family, addiction and unconditional love. Carten turns her camera on her mother Nuala - who has both bipolar disorder and alcoholism - and her wider family, uncovering years of grief, conflict and resilience. Blending intimate contemporary footage with childhood home videos and elements of her artistic practice, the film moves between humour and heartbreak.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: S2 E8 — Donegal TownDermot reaches Donegal Town, discovering a place where Irish tradition and global flavours sit side by side. His day begins at family-run Hannah Hats, where he's fitted in iconic Donegal tweed and learns why this rugged corner of Ireland became famous for its flecked fabric. He visits Chandpur, widely regarded as Ireland's best curry house, where he and Bangladeshi-born chef Rana cook railway curry using outstanding local lamb and potatoes. For pudding, Dermot bakes a classic Irish apple pie with chef Brian McDermott, who explain how the rain improves local produce.

programme.title: Clodagh: Cooking at Home
programme.desc: S1 E2 — The Big GatheringIrish chef and author Clodagh McKenna hosts a big gathering for friends and family in her garden featuring a super-easy menu. Among the dishes she makes for the event are a speedy garden herb dip, a crowd-pleasing chocolate beef chilli and a showstopping tarte Tatin using shop-bought puff pastry.

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: S5 E2The Fletchers start making plans to reclaim more of their farmland, with Kelvin keen to grow oats again, while Liz wants them to try growing maize. All four children get hands-on during lambing, with nine-year-old Marnie bottle feeding a cade lamb after it is rejected by its mother.

programme.title: The Voice UK
programme.desc: S2026 E8Emma Willis hosts as the battle rounds begin, with coaches Tom Jones, Will.i.am, Kelly Rowland, Tom Fletcher and Danny Jones putting their teams through more challenges Joined by special guest mentors, the coaches prepare their artists for a series of head-to-head performances before making the difficult decision of which three singers from each team will progress to the semi-final.

programme.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
programme.desc: S9 E31James cooks two vegan dishes for comedian and TV presenter Sara Pascoe, while the guest chefs are Francesco Mazzei, Richard Bertinet and Alistair Barsby.

programme.title: ITV News
programme.desc: E80 — 18/10/2026A round-up of the latest headlines.

programme.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
programme.desc: S8 E26Alan is joined by Mark Benton, Elizabeth Carling and Bill Fellows, while florist Simon Lycett creates a new centrepiece for the barn using seasonal blooms.

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: S5 E3Liz and Kelvin discover that some farming questions are a lot harder to answer than others when Milo gets inquisitive about artificially inseminating the pigs. The farmhouse clear-out begins in earnest as plans are in for the renovation works, while with the Royal Cheshire Country Show looming, Marnie takes on the challenge of halter-training orphan lamb Hope.

programme.title: Cooking with the Stars
programme.desc: S6 E2 — Budget WeekEmma Willis and Tom Allen host as Bez of Happy Mondays and TV presenters Scarlett Moffatt and Zara McDermott go head-to-head in a three-way cooking battle. With the help of their mentors, they have to produce gourmet dishes with a budget of just £3 a portion, with two of the stars facing the cook-off, after which one will leave the competition.

programme.title: Tomorrow Never Dies
programme.desc: Spy adventure starring Pierce Brosnan, Jonathan Pryce and Michelle Yeoh. Intending to reap the profits of increased ratings for his global multimedia empire, Elliot Carver attempts to ignite a conflict between Britain and China by sinking a British frigate and shooting down a Chinese fighter plane. The British Secret Service sends James Bond to verify suspicions that Carver is behind the incident.

programme.title: Celebrity Lingo

programme.title: Tipping Point: Lucky Stars

Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the better their chances of collecting the £20,000 prize for their selected charity.
